exercises.prompt: Buat revenue, pilih transaksi September, lalu tampilkan dari revenue terbesar ke terkecil.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Periksa pembuatan revenue, filter periode 2025-09, dan sort_values dengan urutan menurun.
exercises.success_feedback: Tepat. Kamu memilih periode dan ukuran sebelum membandingkan transaksi.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
september = transactions[transactions["order_date"].str.startswith("2025-09")]
print(september.sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)[["order_id", "order_date", "region", "revenue"]])

exercises.prompt: Tambahkan revenue dan month, lalu tampilkan tiga baris pertama hasil transformasi.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Pastikan revenue dihitung dari quantity dan unit_price, lalu order_date diproses menjadi month.
exercises.success_feedback: Benar. Kolom turunan membuat definisi ukuran dan periode menjadi terlihat dalam data.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
transactions["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(transactions["order_date"])
transactions["month"] = transactions["order_date"].dt.to_period("M").astype(str)
print(transactions[["order_id", "revenue", "month"]].head(3))

exercises.prompt: Merge transaksi dengan Products, lalu ringkas total revenue per category.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Hubungkan kedua tabel melalui product_id sebelum memakai groupby category dan sum revenue.
exercises.success_feedback: Tepat. Kamu memisahkan fakta transaksi dari konteks product sebelum membuat ringkasan.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
products = pd.read_csv("products.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
sales = transactions.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
summary = sales.groupby("category", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum().sort_values("category")
print(summary)
